notes.title: UPDATE #03 - Important Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
Hello,

Following your feedback we have improved the game and therefore fixed the most annoying bugs that you may have encountered before.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- SHIFT Lagging
- Multiple Crashes due to a loop in the code
- Level Restarting through the exit of lvl 0
- Black Screen after a player die in last level

Thanks,
okeyplaystudio

notes.title: UPDATE #02 - Major Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
Hello,

We fixed the most important bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed - When a player joins a game he is blocked and returns to the menu
[*] Fixed - A player can no longer join a game when he leaves under certain conditions
[/list]

We apologize for the inconvenience,

okeyplaystudio
